weather.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 20 at 10:24AM MST until November 21 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
weather.text:
* WHAT...Snow. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8 inches in the
Park City area and in the Ogden Valley with lower totals in the
lower terrain near Heber City.

* WHERE...Wasatch Back.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. The hazardous
conditions could impact the evening commute.
weather.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For winter road conditions
from the Utah Department of Transportation, visit
http://www.udottraffic.utah.gov.

For graphical depictions of the snowfall forecast, including Official
NWS Forecast, High End Amount, and Low End Amount, visit
weather.gov/slc/winter.

weather.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 20 at 10:24AM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
weather.area: Wasatch Mountains I-80 North; Wasatch Mountains South of I-80
weather.text:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Total snow accumulations between 12 and 24
inches, highest in the Upper Cottonwoods and near the Utah/Idaho
border.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.
weather.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. For winter road conditions from the
Utah Department of Transportation, visit
http://www.udottraffic.utah.gov.
